hierarchy: One epic with 68 native child stories; group IDs are document-local scheduling labels, not new epics.

groups.name: Shared foundation
groups.purpose: Contracts, durable state, reconciliation, APIs and release batching.
groups.entry_points: Start C01; then C02, C08 and W03 can branch out. Other core stories follow their own predecessors.

groups.name: AWS accounts and networking
groups.purpose: Existing/new accounts, network ownership, private transport and service access.
groups.entry_points: Start A01 after C02, C04 and C05; account creation and networking then branch independently.

groups.name: Clusters and application platform
groups.purpose: EKS, recoverable bootstrap, central Argo, application profiles and readiness.
groups.entry_points: W03 starts after C01; W01 follows C08. Cluster execution follows the AWS network contract, then target registration and bootstrap converge.

groups.name: Workspace UI and CLI
groups.purpose: Visible workspace progress, current status and recovery through ordinary clients.
groups.entry_points: U01 and U02 run in parallel after their API/contract predecessors.

groups.name: Lifecycle and migration
groups.purpose: Drift, retirement, shadow adoption, fenced cutover, restore and upgrades.
groups.entry_points: M01 can inventory after C03 and K01. Active cutover support follows platform readiness and authority; retirement has its own ownership checks.

groups.name: Training and capacity
groups.purpose: Plan comparison, approval, jobs, GPU capacity, results, cancellation and checkpoint continuation.
groups.entry_points: T01 follows the shared schema chain; T04 follows C01/W03. Planning, runtime, capacity and experience branch as their own contracts become available.

groups.name: Additional cloud providers
groups.purpose: Azure, GCP and Nebius account/environment, networking and cluster adapters.
groups.entry_points: P01, P04 and P07 start in parallel after C02/C04/C05. Each provider then follows its own networking, infrastructure recipe and cluster path.

groups.name: Deployment and verification
groups.purpose: Three grouped releases, independent live acceptance and existing-workspace cutover execution.
groups.entry_points: R01 assembles the AWS/core source set. R02 and R03 consume that foundation; provider verification is independent. R04 reuses qualified R1 artifacts.
